h2. Why
Every other WarpView ticket writes a module under app/src and needs one way to test it and one way to turn the modules into the single viewer file. Without a fixed build, folder layout and test command, sixteen agents invent sixteen conventions, imports break across modules, and the release cannot produce a file that opens from disk with no server and no network.

h2. What
# {{WARPDEMO/WarpView/app/package.json}}: {{"type": "module"}}, scripts {{test}} = {{node --test}}, {{build}} = {{node build.mjs}} (writes {{WARPDEMO/WarpView/app/dist/viewer.html}}), {{release}} = {{node build.mjs --release}} (writes {{WARPDEMO/WarpView/viewer.html}}); devDependencies pinned exactly: {{esbuild}} 0.24.0 and {{jsdom}} 25.0.1.
# {{WARPDEMO/WarpView/app/build.mjs}}: bundle {{src/main.mjs}} with esbuild (format iife, target es2020, no minify), inline the bundle and every {{src/**/*.css}} (files under {{src/styles/}} first, then path order) into {{src/shell.html}}, and print {{viewer: <path> <bytes>}}.
# {{src/shell.html}}: the regions of SPEC §10.1 with their ids and the data slot {{<script id="warp-data" type="application/json">null</script>}}.
# {{src/main.mjs}}: export {{createApp(\{root, plugins\})}}; for now it renders the empty state of SPEC §10.9.
# {{src/core/util.mjs}}: the helpers of SPEC §4.6 (esc, num, fmtH, fmtN, pct, parseTime, ago, stamp, natKey, natCmp, hashHue) with tests beside them.
# {{WARPDEMO/WarpView/app/.gitignore}}: {{node_modules/}} and {{dist/}}.
# {{WARPDEMO/WarpView/app/test/dom.mjs}}: a helper that loads a built HTML file in jsdom with a given fixture placed in the data slot.

* *AC-1* (happy) Given a clean checkout, when {{npm --prefix WARPDEMO/WarpView/app ci && npm --prefix WARPDEMO/WarpView/app run build}} runs, then {{WARPDEMO/WarpView/app/dist/viewer.html}} exists, has exactly one inline <script> without src, no <link rel=stylesheet>, and shows the text 'Open a Warp run' when opened.
* *AC-2* (happy) Given util.mjs, when called, then fmtH(null) is '—', fmtH(7) is '7h', fmtH(105.5) is '106h', fmtH(36.24) is '36.2h', natCmp('WV-2','WV-10') < 0 and esc('<a href="x">') is '<a href="x">'.
* *AC-3* (negative) Given the built file, when searched for 'http://' and 'https://', then neither appears outside string literals that the spec allows (none in the scaffold): the page fetches nothing.
* *AC-4* (edge) Given a CSS file that fails to parse or a missing src/main.mjs, when build runs, then it exits with status 1 and prints the file name; no partial viewer.html is left behind.
* *AC-5* (happy) Given {{npm --prefix WARPDEMO/WarpView/app test}}, when run, then the util and build tests pass.

h2. Blocked by
WV-01

h2. Why
The viewer must look like the reference page in both themes, at phone width and on paper. If each view picks its own colors and spacing, the six status colors drift, dark mode loses contrast, the page scrolls sideways on a phone and printing cuts the swimlane. One owned set of tokens and layout rules keeps every view consistent and lets the view tickets run in parallel without touching shared CSS.

h2. What
# Create {{WARPDEMO/WarpView/app/src/styles/tokens.css}} and {{WARPDEMO/WarpView/app/src/styles/layout.css}} from SPEC §12 and the reference page {{WARPDEMO/WarpView/ui/reference/warp-dashboard.html}}.
# Tokens on {{:root}} exactly as SPEC §12.1: surface, ink, line and brand colors and the six status colors {{--c-done --c-err --c-prog --c-rev --c-qa --c-todo}}, plus {{--tint}} and {{--tint-todo}}.
# Dark values under {{@media (prefers-color-scheme: dark)}} guarded by {{:root:not([data-theme="light"])}}, and again under {{:root[data-theme="dark"]}}.
# Layout for the top bar, chips, buttons, menu, headline, tabs, metric cards, stack bars, legend chips, search, segmented controls, panels, toasts, drop overlay, empty state (SPEC §10).
# {{@media (max-width: 640px)}} rules of SPEC §10.11 (16 px gutter, cards in one column, top bar wraps).
# {{@media print}} rules of SPEC §10.12 (light tokens, controls hidden, exact colors).

h2. Acceptance
* *AC-1* (happy) Given tokens.css, when parsed, then every custom property listed in SPEC §12.1 is defined on :root with the listed light value and redefined in both dark blocks with the listed dark value.
* *AC-2* (happy) Given the built page with {{WARPDEMO/WarpView/fixtures/beam.sample.json}}, when rendered at 1600 px, then cards, chips and panels match {{WARPDEMO/WarpView/ui/screens/swimlane-plan.png}} in order, spacing and color (same tokens, no new colors).
* *AC-3* (edge) Given a 390 px wide viewport, when the page renders, then document.documentElement.scrollWidth equals the viewport width (no sideways scroll) and metric cards are in one column.
* *AC-4* (negative) Given any CSS file in src/, when searched, then no color literal for a status appears outside tokens.css (views use var(--c-\*) only).
* *AC-5* (happy) Given {{npm --prefix WARPDEMO/WarpView/app test}}, when run, then the tokens test (parses tokens.css and compares to SPEC §12.1) passes.

h2. Locks

h2. Blocked by
WV-01

h2. Why
Warp has sixteen ticket statuses and the screens show six categories. If the mapping lives in each view, the swimlane, board, table, legend and totals disagree about what is in progress, and a status Warp adds later silently becomes invisible. One module owns the mapping, the aliases for hand-written files and the ticket state.json states, and the rule for unknown values.

h2. What
# Create {{WARPDEMO/WarpView/app/src/core/status.mjs}} per SPEC §5. Export:
# {{CATS}} — the six categories in display order with keys {{done err prog rev qa todo}} and labels Completed, Errored / Parked, In Progress, In Review, QA Ready, To Do.
# {{STATUS_CAT}} — the sixteen Warp statuses of SPEC §5.1 to a category key.
# {{STATUS_ALIAS}} for labels found in hand-written files (in\_progress, qa\_ready, to\_do, completed, errored, failed, bugbot and the others in §5.2).
# {{STATE_STATUS}} — ticket state.json states to beam statuses (§5.3).
# {{TERMINAL}}, {{ACTIVE}}, {{normStatus(raw)}} (lower-case, spaces and hyphens to underscores, alias, empty to queued), {{catOf(status)}} (unknown to todo), {{bucketOf(cat)}} (rev and qa count as prog in totals), {{catColor(cat)}} returning the CSS variable, and {{statusText(status)}}.

h2. Acceptance
* *AC-1* (happy) Given each of the sixteen statuses in SPEC §5.1, when catOf runs, then it returns the category listed there; merged, done and skipped are 'done'; awaiting\_approval is 'qa'; alarm, parked and blocked are 'err'.
* *AC-2* (happy) Given 'In Progress', 'QA-Ready' and 'to do', when normStatus runs, then it returns coding, awaiting\_approval and queued.
* *AC-3* (edge) Given an empty string, null or 'teleporting', when normStatus and catOf run, then empty and null become queued and 'teleporting' stays as is with category todo.
* *AC-4* (negative) Given STATE\_STATUS, when asked for 'heartbeat' or 'done', then it returns undefined: those states never move a ticket.
* *AC-5* (happy) Given {{npm --prefix WARPDEMO/WarpView/app test}}, when run, then status.test.mjs passes and checks every key in {{WARPDEMO/WarpView/fixtures/expected/categories.json}}.

h2. Size
M — auto-merge after Bugbot

h2. Locks
{{WARPDEMO/WarpView/app/src/load/parse/}}

h2. Blocked by
WV-03

h2. Why
The viewer is only as good as what it reads. Warp writes a beam, a status file, one state file per ticket, a plan export and, for named runs, a mirror per run. File names change between Warp versions, so the reader must classify by content, merge the copies of one run, and let a newer ticket state move an open ticket. Getting this wrong shows stale or doubled tickets and wrong totals.

h2. What
# Create {{WARPDEMO/WarpView/app/src/load/parse/parse.mjs}} per SPEC §3 and §4.
# {{classify(data)}} returns beam, status, ticket or null by content (§3.1).
# {{runFromBeam(doc)}} builds the Run model of §4 from a beam or a {{kind: warp-plan}} export (estimate at top level, exportedAt), including gate greenAt, evidence, checks and if-red.
# {{runFromStatus}} for status.json alone (no gates, hours from size).
# {{applyState(ticket, state)}} per §3.3: only an open ticket, only when newer, never undoes a merge, copies the PR url and alarm.
# {{buildRuns(docs, extra)}} per §3.2: one run per name, else instance, else folder; the newer copy wins; status.json joins its run; ticket states attach by folder then by id; repo from the first PR url; returns {{\{runs, skipped, overlaid, states\}}}.

h2. Acceptance
* *AC-1* (happy) Given {{WARPDEMO/WarpView/fixtures/beam.sample.json}}, when buildRuns runs, then one run named view with 16 tickets results and every ticket field of SPEC §4.2 is filled as in {{WARPDEMO/WarpView/fixtures/expected/view.run.json}}.
* *AC-2* (happy) Given {{WARPDEMO/WarpView/fixtures/beam.sample.json}} and {{WARPDEMO/WarpView/fixtures/tickets/WV-11/state.json}} (state coding, newer), when buildRuns runs, then WV-11 has status coding, stateNote set, and overlaid is 1.
* *AC-3* (edge) Given {{WARPDEMO/WarpView/fixtures/runs/view/beam.json}} and {{WARPDEMO/WarpView/fixtures/runs/edit/beam.json}} plus an older copy of the view beam, when buildRuns runs, then two runs result, sorted by name, and the newer view copy is kept.
* *AC-4* (edge) Given only {{WARPDEMO/WarpView/fixtures/status.sample.json}}, when buildRuns runs, then one run of kind status results with no gates and hours taken from size (S=4, M=7, L=11, XL=16).
* *AC-5* (negative) Given a JSON file with neither tickets nor done/working/left nor id\+state, when buildRuns runs, then it is counted in skipped and creates no run; a merged ticket with a newer state.json saying coding stays merged.
* *AC-6* (happy) Given {{npm --prefix WARPDEMO/WarpView/app test}}, when run, then parse.test.mjs passes against every fixture under {{WARPDEMO/WarpView/fixtures/}}.

h2. Locks
{{WARPDEMO/WarpView/app/src/load/sources/}}

h2. Blocked by
WV-04

h2. Why
People open the viewer from disk and point it at a .warp folder that keeps changing while the run goes. If reading a folder pulls in the whole repo, if dropping a folder does nothing, or if reload makes them pick the files again every time, they stop using it. The loader has to find the right files, remember how to re-read them, and keep working in browsers without the File System Access API.

h2. What
# Create {{WARPDEMO/WarpView/app/src/load/sources/sources.mjs}} per SPEC §3.4.
# {{openFiles()}} and {{openFolder()}} using showOpenFilePicker / showDirectoryPicker when present, else the hidden inputs (multiple, webkitdirectory).
# Folder walk: prefer a {{.warp}} child; read only files matching {{(beam|status|state)*.json}}; skip {{.git}}, {{node_modules}}, {{__pycache__}}, {{dist}}, {{build}} and {{previous-*}}; depth
# Drop: file system handles when offered, else webkitGetAsEntry traversal.
# {{readSources(sources)}} returns docs {{\{path, data, modified\}}} and errors per file.
# {{reload()}}: re-read handles; a page with embedded data reloads the page; plain input files say to open again.
# Auto-reload every 30 s when the tab is visible, remembered in localStorage inside try/catch.
# {{embeddedDocs(document)}} reads the warp-data slot written by Warp's /warp-dashboard.

h2. Acceptance
* *AC-1* (happy) Given a fake directory handle holding {{.warp/beam.json}}, {{.warp/tickets/WV-11/state.json}}, {{.warp/agents.json}} and {{node_modules/x/beam.json}}, when the folder is read, then exactly the beam and the state file are returned with paths starting with the folder name.
* *AC-2* (happy) Given the warp-data slot holds \{files:\[\{path,data\}\]\}, when embeddedDocs runs, then it returns those docs and reload() calls location.reload.
* *AC-3* (edge) Given a browser without showOpenFilePicker, when Open status files is chosen, then the hidden file input is clicked and its files are read on change.
* *AC-4* (negative) Given localStorage throws on access, when auto-reload is toggled, then no exception escapes and the toggle still works for the session.
* *AC-5* (happy) Given {{npm --prefix WARPDEMO/WarpView/app test}}, when run, then sources.test.mjs passes using fake handles and jsdom.

h2. Why
Warp runs a plan in gate blocks and, by default, starts a block only when the blocks before it are cleared. The swimlane, the board lanes and the people-hour totals all depend on which block a ticket belongs to. If the viewer assigns blocks differently from Warp, the plan it draws is not the plan Warp runs and the gate lines land in the wrong place.

h2. What
# Create {{WARPDEMO/WarpView/app/src/model/blocks/blocks.mjs}}, a port of Warp's scripts/blocks.py as specified in SPEC §6.
# {{gateKeys(run)}}: G-number keys in numeric order, then other keys in plan order.
# {{assignBlocks(run)}}: a ticket's block is its own gate when that gate exists, else the lowest gate that lists it as a member, else the highest block among its dependencies (cycles cut), else the first block; with no gates every block is null.
# {{blockStates(run)}}: per block the ticket ids, counts of merged, open, parked and queued, the gate status and {{cleared}} (every ticket merged, done or skipped and the gate not red).
# Sets {{run.blockRank}}.

h2. Why
The deliverable is one file people open from disk. It must be built from the merged modules, committed, match the design of record on every fixture, and say clearly that it never changes a run: resetting a ticket is WarpEdit. Without a release ticket the repo holds modules nobody can open.

h2. What
# Run {{npm --prefix WARPDEMO/WarpView/app run release}} to write {{WARPDEMO/WarpView/viewer.html}} and commit it.
# Write {{WARPDEMO/WarpView/app/README.md}}: what the viewer is, how to open it, what it reads (beam.json, status.json, ticket state.json, WARP\_PLAN.json exports, a .warp folder, several runs), the keys, the three views and the two clocks, and that it is read-only (resetting a phase is WarpEdit, {{WARPDEMO/WarpEdit/editor.html}}).
# {{WARPDEMO/WarpView/app/test/parity.test.mjs}}: load viewer.html in jsdom with each fixture and compare blocks, plan, metrics and the table order with {{WARPDEMO/WarpView/fixtures/expected/}}; assert no element with data-edit and no text 'Reset'.
# Capture the eleven screens and compare them with {{WARPDEMO/WarpView/ui/screens/*.png}} (layout and color; small font differences pass).

h2. Acceptance
* *AC-1* (happy) Given {{npm --prefix WARPDEMO/WarpView/app run release}}, when run, then {{WARPDEMO/WarpView/viewer.html}} is written, is under 400 kB and opens from disk with the empty state.
* *AC-2* (happy) Given viewer.html with {{WARPDEMO/WarpView/fixtures/beam.sample.json}} dropped on it, when compared, then blocks, plan, metrics and table order equal {{WARPDEMO/WarpView/fixtures/expected/}}.
* *AC-3* (negative) Given viewer.html, when searched, then it has no element with data-edit, no 'Reset' control and no network URL in markup or script.
* *AC-4* (edge) Given the README, when read, then it names WarpEdit for resets and gives the sample path fixtures/beam.sample.json.
* *AC-5* (happy) Given {{npm --prefix WARPDEMO/WarpView/app test}}, when run, then parity.test.mjs passes.
